messages.subject: Changing thickness of internal branches
parts:
Dear all,

Is it possible to reduce thickness of internal branches in ggtree?

For instance

require(ggtree)
data(chiroptera, package="ape")
groupInfo <- split(chiroptera$tip.label, gsub("_\\w+", "", chiroptera$tip.label))
chiroptera <- groupOTU(chiroptera, groupInfo)
ggtree(chiroptera, aes(color=group), layout='circular') + geom_tiplab(size=1, aes(angle=angle))
ggsave("tree.png")

produce branches that are too large.

Sincerely
Michael

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Changing thickness of internal branches
parts:
try something like this:

require(ggplot2)
require(ggtree)
x <- rtree(30)
ggtree(x, aes(size=isTip)) +
    scale_size_manual(values=c(.5, 1))
